decisions.rationale: Chronic anterior blepharitis is a different condition from the one described in the leaves.
TNF-α inhibitor-induced psoriasiform dermatitis is a broader condition and does not specifically match the leaf description.

option_relations.rationale: Chronic anterior blepharitis is a different condition from the one described in the leaves.
TNF-α inhibitor-induced psoriasiform dermatitis is a broader condition and does not specifically match the leaf description.
TNF-α inhibitor–induced psoriasiform blepharitis is a specific type of drug-induced blepharitis and ectropion associated with TNF-α inhibitors.
Drug-induced blepharitis and ectropion associated with TNF-α inhibitors (infliximab and adalimumab) matches the leaf description.
